request.instruction: Fill the audio semantic mask based on the given conditions:
request.caption: Cinematic progressive soul suite: close-miked expressive lead vocal, stacked call-and-response harmonies, felt piano, syncopated drums, bowed strings, brass swells, granular ambience, recurring four-note motif, dynamic but unclipped master, precise stereo placement, verses restrained and conversational, pre-choruses steadily rising, choruses broad and luminous, bridge sparse before a final full-band return.
request.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The map was folded underneath the cup
Blue ink rivers where the roads gave up
We wrote the names of towns we never knew
And left one empty line to lead us through
The station clock was leaning into dawn
The platform hummed after everyone had gone
I heard the rails repeat a four-note phrase
A small machine remembering our days

[Pre-Chorus]
If every mile is borrowed time
Let every signal turn in time

[Chorus]
Hold the horizon, hold it steady
Carry the color when the sky is heavy
Call through the distance, clear and true
I will leave the porch light on for you

[Verse 2]
The orchard kept the weather in its leaves
The radio spoke softly through the eaves
A kettle traced a circle in the air
As if the room still knew that you were there
I fixed the latch and swept the hallway clean
Found summer dust behind the washing machine
The ordinary things refused to fade
They kept the shape of every choice we made

[Pre-Chorus]
If every mile is borrowed time
Let every signal turn in time

[Chorus]
Hold the horizon, hold it steady
Carry the color when the sky is heavy
Call through the distance, clear and true
I will leave the porch light on for you

[Bridge]
No grand arrival, no parade
Only the sound the screen door made
One quiet footstep, then another
Rain on the roof and light on water
We do not need to name the weather
We only need to stand together

[Final Chorus]
Hold the horizon, hold it steady
Carry the color, I am ready
Call through the distance, clear and true
Every road has led me back to you
Hold the horizon through the blue
I kept the final open line for you

[Outro]
Four notes fading down the track
One light saying you can come back
